name: Halara Nightmare
source:
One of the Master Detectives dispatched to Kanai Ward. Their Forte is Postcognition.

Halara is always cool under fire and has solved many difficult cases through precise judgement. Halara only believes in money and will not accept a request without payment, regardless of who the client may be.

[From [url=https://www.spike-chunsoft.co.jp/raincode/en/character/]official website[/url]]
